title: Norwegian-Style Shiitake Mushroom Wrap
description: A delicate and flavorful wrap filled with sautéed shiitake mushrooms, inspired by Norwegian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add olive oil and sauté the sliced shiitake mushrooms until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Brush the large wrap with olive oil and toast for 1-2 minutes, until lightly browned.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the cooked mushroom mixture down the center, followed by crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: serve with lemon wedges on the side.
